To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

multiple synovectomy of the knee and wrist is an effective treatment in refractory rheumatoids arthritis (RA), with significant reduction in pain and disability and a decrease in radiological progression.

1) multiple synovectomies in patients with refractory RA can improve disease activity in the short and medium term, 2) the effect of synovectomy on disease activity is independent of the type of synovectomy, 3) synovectomy can reduce radiological progression, 4) synovectomy is a cost-effective procedure in the short and long term, and 5) the effect of a synovectomy is maintained for at least 5 years.
the long-term results of multiple joint synovectomy are good in patients with refractory RA, in terms of disease activity, joint destruction, and quality of life.
